title: Thinking that existed is linked to its rows, model answers name the request that made them, and every row without reasoning says why
request: The owner: fix the routing readings without thinking (1,278 of 1,434) and the m1, m2, m3, m6 and m7 judges rows made by a model without thinking.
spec: Measure each gap before calling it lost; link any kept thinking exactly (same request, same purpose, same answer, the run's own window); never borrow another call's thinking, never write reasoning for the model; record the request on model answers from now on; give every remaining row a true reason, and keep only unexplained gaps in the list.
plan: Break the routing readings down by their notes
Find why the plain arm and the written requests' checker found no exchange
Check whether ledger model answers can be joined to their calls
Record the acting request on model answers; link it in the decision sets
A no_reasoning field on decision rows and episode steps (dclab-core 0.145.0)

decisions.decision: No reasoning is written for old rows; only thinking the API returned and the gateway kept is linked
decisions.why: the owner cancelled every backfill on 2026-10-28: thinking that was never kept does not exist, and a reason written afterwards would not be the model's

decisions.decision: The request is set only around the tool call it made (an acting request in the runtime), never 'the last call in this context'
decisions.why: the review found the last call is often another's: three sub-problems routed first and recorded after would all get the third one's thinking

decisions.decision: A plain reading links only to a JSON-wrapped call with the same answer inside its own run's window, or the single such call
decisions.why: the same dev cases were read by many runs; a call of another run, or one that gave another answer, must never lend its thinking

decisions.decision: Exam calls, copies of a workspace's own row, lost runs and calls where the model did not think are counted as explained
decisions.why: none of them can be fixed; the gap list keeps only what is missing and could still be captured

decisions.decision: Thinking from a workspace that does not allow training is never linked, and a linked exchange's provenance joins the row
decisions.why: consent decides what may be trained on, and a row must say where each part came from

change: dclab_rnd.store.sets.routing: exchanges keep the request inside a JSON message (asked), plain_call links a plain reading strictly, exact joins check the purpose, readings carry EXAM, COPY, LOST_RUN, LOST_GONE notes, counts add explained. dclab_rnd.experience: acting_request, set by dclab_rnd.agents.runtime only around a tool call with the reply's request; dclab_rnd.ledger.answer names it on a model's answer. dclab_rnd.store.sets.decisions: thinking_by_request (train consent only), the used answer's thinking linked from its own agent's request with its provenance, and no_reasoning notes. dclab-core 0.145.0: decision_example.v4 and episode.v3 add no_reasoning. m6: the first move names its actor, DCLab Code steps take the session's kept thinking. Coverage and the store check count the new classes.

findings.scenario: The Home eval's plain arm and the written requests' checker send {"request": ..., "tables": ...} as purpose home_agent; the routing join compared the whole message with the request's words
findings.cause: the join read the user message whole, and looked for purpose home_eval_plain, which no call used
findings.fix: the request inside a JSON message is matched, with the same answer, inside the run's window

findings.defect: A model's answer in the ledger named no request
findings.scenario: The intern's identifier and leak decisions (2,284 each) carried no link to the call whose thinking explains them
findings.cause: capture recorded the model's answer without the request that made its tool call
findings.fix: the runtime sets the acting request around each tool call, and the ledger's answer names it

findings.defect: The first version named the wrong request on many answers
findings.scenario: Home's problem map routes sub-problems sp1, sp2 and sp3, then records them: all three answers took sp3's request and its thinking; a served answer took its shadow's call
findings.cause: every model answer took the last model request of its context
findings.fix: only an answer recorded inside a model's own tool call names its request

findings.defect: The plain match could borrow another call
findings.scenario: With no answer, any home_agent call whose reply named no track matched; with no time limit the earliest of many runs' calls was taken
findings.cause: a loose text match with no run window
findings.fix: JSON-wrapped calls only, a real answer, the run's own window, or exactly one call

findings.defect: Notes said things that were not true
findings.scenario: COPY for runs that kept no workspace or kept one before its ledger held the model's reading; 'lost before 30 Oct' for new rows; 'the rule was used' when a person was; a shadow's answer counted as used
findings.cause: notes chosen without checking the run's keep, the record's date, who was used, or the shadow marker
findings.fix: COPY only for kept runs after 29 Oct 11:06; dated and undated notes apart; the note names what was used; shadow answers skipped

findings.scenario: A live test's exchanges kept in a workspace that does not allow training could lend their thinking to a training row
findings.fix: only train-consent exchanges, with their provenance added to the row

findings.defect: The store check did not know the no_model class
findings.scenario: test_store_check failed on the sets' REASONING.json since the no_model class was added earlier the same day
findings.cause: the check's list of known sources was not updated
findings.fix: no_model added to the known sources

measurements.name: routing readings without thinking, by reason
measurements.gate: each reading's missing thinking explained by its note or linked
measurements.result: 1,741 readings: 809 plain (join fixed), 588 eval Home arm (copy or lost by run), 288 exam, 37 model did not think, 18 no exchange

measurements.name: ledger model answers
measurements.gate: a model's answer links to its call
measurements.result: 8,564 model answers named no request before this change; from now on an answer inside a model's tool call names it
limits: older answers cannot be linked and say so

outcome: Thinking that existed is linked exactly; future model answers link their calls; the remaining rows say why they have none, and the gap list shows only gaps that could still be captured.
lessons: Measure a gap before calling it lost: most of these readings had a join problem, not a missing thinking
A 'last call' value is a guess: tie a decision to the call that made it at the moment it is made
A note that explains a gap must be checked as carefully as the data it explains
risks: Redacted thinking is labelled recorded; the label does not say it was redacted
Decisions recorded by a model outside its own tool call still name no request
